about: The meta's endgame section: what endgame content Forever has opened, what is announced with its day, and what is shut. The gear advice (wowstats.endgame) reads it: a raid, a world boss, the Dungeon Set 2 chain or a world event counts only when its entry is `open` or its `opens` day has come, or when ForeverDB.net saw the source in Forever; endgame content with no entry is shut. The weekly meta pass (tools/kb/meta.py, `endgame`) proposes status changes from the news, folded here by tools/kb/lifecycle.py; `match` is ours, never the model's.

onyxias-lair.name: Onyxia's Lair
onyxias-lair.statement: Onyxia's Lair (40 players) opens on 9 Dec 2026 with Barrow Deeps and Hyjal Summit. Her head's quests open with it.

barrow-deeps.name: Barrow Deeps
barrow-deeps.statement: Barrow Deeps (10 players, 8 bosses) opens on 9 Dec 2026, weekly reset.

hyjal-summit.name: Hyjal Summit
hyjal-summit.statement: Hyjal Summit (20 players, 13 bosses) opens on 9 Dec 2026, weekly reset.

scarlet-enclave.name: Scarlet Enclave
scarlet-enclave.statement: A Scarlet Enclave raid is announced for Forever with no day.

molten-core.name: Molten Core
molten-core.statement: Forever launched with levelling, the dungeons and PvP open and no raid; Molten Core has no announced day, so it stays shut until a source opens it.

dungeon-set-2.name: Dungeon Set 2 (Lord Valthalak's chain)
dungeon-set-2.statement: Blizzard lists Lord Valthalak's chain, from An Earnest Proposition to Saving the Best for Last, as a Legacy challenge, but no source says it is open: the Dungeon Set 2 quests and the bosses its brazier summons stay shut.

world-bosses.name: World bosses
world-bosses.statement: Forever's launch list of what is open (levelling, dungeons, PvP) names no world boss: Azuregos, Lord Kazzak, the Emerald Dragons and the other level-63 bosses outside instances stay shut.

gurubashi-arena.name: Gurubashi Arena chest event
gurubashi-arena.statement: The launch list names no world event, and ForeverDB.net has the Arena Treasure Chest from Classic's data only.

ahnqiraj-war-effort.name: Ahn'Qiraj war effort
ahnqiraj-war-effort.statement: The war effort opens Ahn'Qiraj, which no source has announced.

abyssal-council.name: Abyssal Council summons (Silithus)
abyssal-council.statement: The Silithus windstone summons came with Ahn'Qiraj in Classic; the launch list doesn't name them.

alterac-valley-summons.name: Alterac Valley's summoned bosses
alterac-valley-summons.statement: Alterac Valley is a live battleground (Blizzard's hotfixes fix bugs on its map), so Ivus and Lokholar, summoned there, are no world bosses.

blackrock-depths.name: Blackrock Depths
blackrock-depths.statement: Blackrock Depths is open: Forever launched with the Classic dungeons and its 9 new ones, and the Master Spelunker achievement lists it.
